requirements.description: Same-cycle non-MMU DTLB PPN in load_store_unit, combinational and queued speculative non-idempotent load branch resolution across lsu_bypass and load_unit, and SEND_TAG exception retirement with killed/aborted load-buffer slot reclamation.
32-bit word-granular ([11:2]) store-buffer page-offset hazard detection and two-phase CBO commit-queue completion handshaking.
Critical-path AGU/control and storage optimization across the LSU subsystem achieving setup/hold slack >= 0.0 ns at 1.80 ns clock and area <= 8260.0 um^2.
